B2L06-G01-P143.title: Practice: V好（V好了／沒V好／V得好／V不好）

items.prompt: The internet in your new home works now, so you can go online and play games. Say it with V好.

promptZh.traditional: 新家的網路可以用，你可以上網玩遊戲了。用「好」說。
promptZh.simplified: 新家的网络可以用，你可以上网玩游戏了。用「好」说。

repairs.note: 好嗎 makes a question; here you say the internet is ready.
壞了 means broken; the internet works now.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 網路 + 裝好了 + ，我可以上網玩遊戲了。

result.traditional: 網路裝好了，我可以上網玩遊戲了。
result.simplified: 网络装好了，我可以上网玩游戏了。
result.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhuāng hǎo le, wǒ kěyǐ shàngwǎng wán yóuxì le.
result.english: The internet is set up, so I can go online and play games.

alternatives.traditional: 網路弄好了，我可以上網玩遊戲了。
alternatives.simplified: 网络弄好了，我可以上网玩游戏了。
alternatives.pinyin: Wǎnglù nòng hǎo le, wǒ kěyǐ shàngwǎng wán yóuxì le.
alternatives.english: The internet is set up, so I can go online and play games.

items.successNote: V好了 says the action is finished and ready.

items.prompt: The materials for tomorrow’s meeting are not ready yet. Ask what to do, with V好.

promptZh.traditional: 明天開會要用的資料還沒好，怎麼辦？用「好」說。
promptZh.simplified: 明天开会要用的资料还没好，怎么办？用「好」说。

segments.traditional: 明天開會要用的資料，我還沒
segments.simplified: 明天开会要用的资料，我还没

repairs.note: V得 needs a comment after it; here the materials are not ready.
準備錯 means prepared the wrong thing; they are just not ready.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我還沒 + 準備好 + ，怎麼辦？

result.traditional: 明天開會要用的資料，我還沒準備好，怎麼辦？
result.simplified: 明天开会要用的资料，我还没准备好，怎么办？
result.pinyin: Míngtiān kāihuì yào yòng de zīliào, wǒ hái méi zhǔnbèi hǎo, zěnme bàn?
result.english: I haven't got the materials for tomorrow's meeting ready yet. What should I do?

items.successNote: 還沒V好: not finished and ready yet.

items.prompt: I heard Chinese is not easy. Do you think one year is enough? Say it with V得好.

promptZh.traditional: 聽說學中文不容易。你覺得一年夠嗎？用「得」說。
promptZh.simplified: 听说学中文不容易。你觉得一年够吗？用「得」说。

segments.traditional: 聽說學中文不容易，一年
segments.simplified: 听说学中文不容易，一年

repairs.note: The question asks whether you can learn it well, not about a bad result.
好學 describes a subject as easy to learn; here you ask how well someone can learn it.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一年 + 學得好 + 嗎？

result.traditional: 聽說學中文不容易，一年學得好嗎？
result.simplified: 听说学中文不容易，一年学得好吗？
result.pinyin: Tīngshuō xué Zhōngwén bù róngyì, yì nián xué de hǎo ma?
result.english: I heard Chinese is not easy. Can you learn it well in one year?

items.successNote: V得好 asks how well an action is done.

items.prompt: It is his first time singing this song. Say the result with V好.

promptZh.traditional: 他第一次唱這首歌。用「好」說。
promptZh.simplified: 他第一次唱这首歌。用「好」说。

segments.traditional: 他第一次唱這首歌，所以還
segments.simplified: 他第一次唱这首歌，所以还

repairs.note: It is his first time, so he does not sing it well.
唱好 means finish singing; 還 shows the result is not good yet.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 所以還 + 唱不好.

result.traditional: 他第一次唱這首歌，所以還唱不好。
result.simplified: 他第一次唱这首歌，所以还唱不好。
result.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì chàng zhè shǒu gē, suǒyǐ hái chàng bu hǎo.
result.english: It is his first time singing this song, so he still cannot sing it well.

items.successNote: V不好 says the result of the action is not good.

items.prompt: Dinner is ready, so you can eat. Say it with V好.

promptZh.traditional: 晚飯可以吃了。用「好」說。
promptZh.simplified: 晚饭可以吃了。用「好」说。

sentence.traditional: 晚飯做好了，可以吃。
sentence.simplified: 晚饭做好了，可以吃。
sentence.pinyin: Wǎnfàn zuò hǎo le, kěyǐ chī.
sentence.english: Dinner is ready, so you can eat.

repairs.note: 吃完 means finish eating; dinner is only ready now.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 晚飯 + 做好 + 了 + 可以 + 吃.
items.successNote: 做好 says the cooking is finished and the food is ready.

items.prompt: He sings beautifully, so everyone likes listening. Say it with V得 + comment.

promptZh.traditional: 他唱歌很好聽，大家喜歡聽。用「得」說。
promptZh.simplified: 他唱歌很好听，大家喜欢听。用「得」说。

sentence.traditional: 他唱得好，大家喜歡聽。
sentence.simplified: 他唱得好，大家喜欢听。
sentence.pinyin: Tā chàng de hǎo, dàjiā xǐhuān tīng.
sentence.english: He sings well, so everyone likes listening.

repairs.note: 唱好 means finish singing, not sing well.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 他 + 唱得 + 好 + 大家 + 喜歡聽.
items.successNote: V得好 + comment judges how well the action is done.

items.prompt: This is bus 99, not bus 299. Tell your friend with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 這是99公車，不是299公車。用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这是99公车，不是299公车。用「错」说。

repairs.note: Add 了: the wrong bus is already a finished result.
坐得好 means sat well; the bus is the wrong one.
坐好了 means seated and ready, not the wrong bus.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 你 + 坐錯了.

result.traditional: 這是99公車，不是299公車，你坐錯了。
result.simplified: 这是99公车，不是299公车，你坐错了。
result.pinyin: Zhè shì jiǔshíjiǔ gōngchē, bú shì èr bǎi jiǔshíjiǔ gōngchē, nǐ zuò cuò le.
result.english: This is bus 99, not bus 299; you took the wrong bus.

items.successNote: V錯了 says the action was done with a wrong result.

items.prompt: The map is not clear. What may happen if you walk by it? Say it with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 這張地圖不清楚。看這張地圖走，會有什麼問題？用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这张地图不清楚。看这张地图走，会有什么问题？用「错」说。

segments.traditional: 這張地圖不清楚，要是你看著地圖走，可能會
segments.simplified: 这张地图不清楚，要是你看着地图走，可能会

repairs.note: 走好 means walk properly; the map leads you the wrong way.
You are walking, not taking a vehicle.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 可能會 + 走錯路.

result.traditional: 這張地圖不清楚，要是你看著地圖走，可能會走錯路。
result.simplified: 这张地图不清楚，要是你看着地图走，可能会走错路。
result.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú bù qīngchǔ, yàoshi nǐ kànzhe dìtú zǒu, kěnéng huì zǒu cuò lù.
result.english: This map is not clear. If you walk by it, you may take the wrong way.

alternatives.traditional: 這張地圖不清楚，要是你看著地圖走，可能會走錯。
alternatives.simplified: 这张地图不清楚，要是你看着地图走，可能会走错。
alternatives.pinyin: Zhè zhāng dìtú bù qīngchǔ, yàoshi nǐ kànzhe dìtú zǒu, kěnéng huì zǒu cuò.
alternatives.english: This map is not clear. If you walk by it, you may go the wrong way.

items.successNote: V錯 + object names the wrong result.

items.prompt: The address on this letter is wrong. Complete both blanks with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 這封信的地址不對。用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这封信的地址不对。用「错」说。

repairs.note: The address was written wrong; 送錯 belongs in the second blank.
寫錯 belongs in the first blank; the post office delivered it wrong.
寫好 means finished writing; the address itself is wrong.
送好 means delivered properly; 所以 shows the delivery went wrong.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 地址 + 寫錯 + 了，所以郵局的人就 + 送錯 + 了地方.

result.traditional: 這封信的地址寫錯了，所以郵局的人就送錯了地方。
result.simplified: 这封信的地址写错了，所以邮局的人就送错了地方。
result.pinyin: Zhè fēng xìn de dìzhǐ xiě cuò le, suǒyǐ yóujú de rén jiù sòng cuò le dìfāng.
result.english: The address on this letter was written wrong, so the post office delivered it to the wrong place.

items.successNote: Each action gets its own V錯 result.

items.prompt: The husband cannot get into his house. Complete what he says with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 先生站在門口，進不去。用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 先生站在门口，进不去。用「错」说。

items.sub: 太太：你怎麼站在門口，不進去呢？

segments.traditional: 了鑰匙，進不去，還好你回來了。
segments.simplified: 了钥匙，进不去，还好你回来了。

repairs.note: 拿好 means holding it properly; the key is the wrong one.
帶好 means brought it properly; he could not get in.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我出門的時候 + 拿錯 + 了鑰匙.

result.traditional: 我出門的時候拿錯了鑰匙，進不去，還好你回來了。
result.simplified: 我出门的时候拿错了钥匙，进不去，还好你回来了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ chūmén de shíhou ná cuò le yàoshi, jìn bu qù, hái hǎo nǐ huílái le.
result.english: I took the wrong key when I went out and could not get in. Good thing you are back.

alternatives.traditional: 我出門的時候帶錯了鑰匙，進不去，還好你回來了。
alternatives.simplified: 我出门的时候带错了钥匙，进不去，还好你回来了。
alternatives.pinyin: Wǒ chūmén de shíhou dài cuò le yàoshi, jìn bu qù, hái hǎo nǐ huílái le.
alternatives.english: I brought the wrong key when I went out and could not get in. Good thing you are back.

items.successNote: V錯了 + 了 marks a finished action with a wrong result.

items.prompt: Your friend invites you to KTV, but you do not want to go. Complete your reply with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友找你去KTV，你不想去。用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友找你去KTV，你不想去。用「错」说。

repairs.note: You are afraid of singing wrong, not of singing well.
V得 needs a comment after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我怕 + 唱錯 + 會被你們笑.

result.traditional: 我不去，我怕唱錯會被你們笑。
result.simplified: 我不去，我怕唱错会被你们笑。
result.pinyin: Wǒ bú qù, wǒ pà chàng cuò huì bèi nǐmen xiào.
result.english: I am not going. I am afraid I will sing wrong and you will laugh at me.

items.successNote: V錯 can stand alone before a consequence.

items.prompt: It is extremely hot today. Ask your friend with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 今天熱得不得了。用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 今天热得不得了。用「错」说。

items.sub: B：我早上出門的時候覺得有一點兒冷，沒想到現在這麼熱。

segments.traditional: 衣服了？今天熱得不得了！
segments.simplified: 衣服了？今天热得不得了！

repairs.note: 穿好 means dressed; the problem is the wrong clothes.
V得 needs a comment after it.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 你是不是 + 穿錯 + 衣服了？

result.traditional: 你是不是穿錯衣服了？今天熱得不得了！
result.simplified: 你是不是穿错衣服了？今天热得不得了！
result.pinyin: Nǐ shì bu shì chuān cuò yīfu le? Jīntiān rè de bùdéliǎo!
result.english: Did you put on the wrong clothes? It is extremely hot today!

items.successNote: V錯 names the action that produced the wrong result.

items.prompt: You were late. Say why, with V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 你遲到了，因為時間不對。用「錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你迟到了，因为时间不对。用「错」说。

sentence.traditional: 我記錯了時間，所以遲到了。
sentence.simplified: 我记错了时间，所以迟到了。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ jì cuò le shíjiān, suǒyǐ chídào le.
sentence.english: I remembered the time wrong, so I was late.

repairs.note: 但是 marks contrast; being late is the result, so use 所以.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我 + 記錯了 + 時間 + 所以 + 遲到了.
items.successNote: V錯了 + object states what was done wrong.

items.prompt: Your friend is afraid you got his birthday wrong. Reassure him with 沒V錯.

promptZh.traditional: 朋友怕你記錯他的生日。用「沒……錯」說。
promptZh.simplified: 朋友怕你记错他的生日。用「没……错」说。

repairs.note: Do not use 了 after 沒: say 沒記錯.
記好 means remembered it well; here you say you did not get it wrong.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我沒 + 記錯.

result.traditional: 別擔心，我沒記錯，明天真的是他的生日。
result.simplified: 别担心，我没记错，明天真的是他的生日。
result.pinyin: Bié dānxīn, wǒ méi jì cuò, míngtiān zhēn de shì tā de shēngrì.
result.english: Don't worry, I did not get it wrong. Tomorrow really is his birthday.

items.successNote: 沒V錯 is negative and never takes 了.

B2L06-G03-P145.title: Practice: V會（V會了／沒V會／V得會／V不會）

items.prompt: This dance is hard. After two days of trying, I still have not learned it. Say it with 沒V會.

promptZh.traditional: 這個舞好難。我學了兩天，一點兒也不會。用「沒……會」說。
promptZh.simplified: 这个舞好难。我学了两天，一点儿也不会。用「没……会」说。

segments.traditional: 這個舞好難，我學了兩天，還是
segments.simplified: 这个舞好难，我学了两天，还是

repairs.note: 學會了 says he did learn it; 還是 shows he did not.
The task asks for 沒……會: 沒學會.
沒學好 means not learned well; he cannot do it at all, so 沒學會.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 還是 + 沒學會.

result.traditional: 這個舞好難，我學了兩天，還是沒學會。
result.simplified: 这个舞好难，我学了两天，还是没学会。
result.pinyin: Zhège wǔ hǎo nán, wǒ xué le liǎng tiān, háishì méi xuéhuì.
result.english: This dance is hard. I learned it for two days and still have not mastered it.

items.successNote: 沒學會 says the result was not achieved.

items.prompt: On the first day of class, the teacher taught me how to write my Chinese name. Say it with V會.

promptZh.traditional: 上課的第一天，老師教我寫自己的中文名字。用「會」說。
promptZh.simplified: 上课的第一天，老师教我写自己的中文名字。用「会」说。

segments.traditional: 我怎麼寫自己的中文名字了。
segments.simplified: 我怎么写自己的中文名字了。

repairs.note: 教得 needs a comment after it.
教錯 means taught it wrong; he learned to write it.
學會 is what the student did; the teacher 教會 him.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 老師就 + 教會 + 我怎麼寫自己的中文名字了.

result.traditional: 上課的第一天，老師就教會我怎麼寫自己的中文名字了。
result.simplified: 上课的第一天，老师就教会我怎么写自己的中文名字了。
result.pinyin: Shàngkè de dì yī tiān, lǎoshī jiù jiāo huì wǒ zěnme xiě zìjǐ de Zhōngwén míngzi le.
result.english: On the first day of class, the teacher taught me how to write my own Chinese name.

items.successNote: 教會 says the teaching succeeded.

items.prompt: No one taught you to play soccer, but you can play. Ask how you learned it, with V會.

promptZh.traditional: 沒有人教你踢足球，可是你會踢。用「會」說。
promptZh.simplified: 没有人教你踢足球，可是你会踢。用「会」说。

sentence.traditional: 沒有人教你踢足球，你自己怎麼學會的？
sentence.simplified: 没有人教你踢足球，你自己怎么学会的？
sentence.pinyin: Méi yǒu rén jiāo nǐ tī zúqiú, nǐ zìjǐ zěnme xuéhuì de?
sentence.english: No one taught you to play soccer. How did you learn it yourself?

sentence.traditional: 沒有人教你踢足球，你自己怎麼學得會的？
sentence.simplified: 没有人教你踢足球，你自己怎么学得会的？
sentence.pinyin: Méi yǒu rén jiāo nǐ tī zúqiú, nǐ zìjǐ zěnme xué de huì de?
sentence.english: No one taught you to play soccer. How did you manage to learn it yourself?

repairs.note: 怎麼V會……的 asks how; 學會了 states the result.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 你自己 + 怎麼 + 學會 + 的？
items.successNote: 怎麼V會…的 asks how an achievement happened.

items.prompt: You want driving lessons. Complete both lines with V會.

promptZh.traditional: 你想請朋友教你開車。用「會」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你想请朋友教你开车。用「会」说。

segments.traditional: 我想請你教我開車，一個月
segments.simplified: 我想请你教我开车，一个月

segments.traditional: 要是你每天練習，也許兩個星期就
segments.simplified: 要是你每天练习，也许两个星期就

repairs.note: Use 學得會 to ask whether you can learn it; 學會了 says it is already done.
You have not started; the question is whether you can learn it.
The second blank is about you learning, not about teaching.
B says you will learn it, so 沒學會 is the opposite.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 一個月 + 學得會 + 嗎？也許兩個星期就 + 學會了.

result.traditional: 我想請你教我開車，一個月學得會嗎？要是你每天練習，也許兩個星期就學會了。
result.simplified: 我想请你教我开车，一个月学得会吗？要是你每天练习，也许两个星期就学会了。
result.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ jiāo wǒ kāichē, yí ge yuè xué de huì ma? Yàoshi nǐ měi tiān liànxí, yěxǔ liǎng ge xīngqī jiù xuéhuì le.
result.english: I want you to teach me to drive. Can I learn it in a month? If you practice every day, maybe you will learn it in two weeks.

items.successNote: V得會 asks about the ability; V會了 states the achieved result.

alternatives.traditional: 我想請你教我開車，一個月教得會嗎？要是你每天練習，也許兩個星期就學會了。
alternatives.simplified: 我想请你教我开车，一个月教得会吗？要是你每天练习，也许两个星期就学会了。
alternatives.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ jiāo wǒ kāichē, yí ge yuè jiāo de huì ma? Yàoshi nǐ měi tiān liànxí, yěxǔ liǎng ge xīngqī jiù xuéhuì le.
alternatives.english: I want you to teach me to drive. Can you teach me in a month? If you practice every day, maybe you will learn it in two weeks.

alternatives.traditional: 我想請你教我開車，一個月學得會嗎？要是你每天練習，也許兩個星期就學得會。
alternatives.simplified: 我想请你教我开车，一个月学得会吗？要是你每天练习，也许两个星期就学得会。
alternatives.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ jiāo wǒ kāichē, yí ge yuè xué de huì ma? Yàoshi nǐ měi tiān liànxí, yěxǔ liǎng ge xīngqī jiù xué de huì.
alternatives.english: I want you to teach me to drive. Can I learn it in a month? If you practice every day, maybe you will be able to learn it in two weeks.

alternatives.traditional: 我想請你教我開車，一個月教得會嗎？要是你每天練習，也許兩個星期就學得會。
alternatives.simplified: 我想请你教我开车，一个月教得会吗？要是你每天练习，也许两个星期就学得会。
alternatives.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ jiāo wǒ kāichē, yí ge yuè jiāo de huì ma? Yàoshi nǐ měi tiān liànxí, yěxǔ liǎng ge xīngqī jiù xué de huì.
alternatives.english: I want you to teach me to drive. Can you teach me in a month? If you practice every day, maybe you will be able to learn it in two weeks.

items.prompt: That child is too young. Say it with 會.

promptZh.traditional: 那個孩子太小了。用「會」說。
promptZh.simplified: 那个孩子太小了。用「会」说。

repairs.note: The child is too young; the teacher cannot teach him.
教會了 says the teacher succeeded; 太小 gives the opposite.

promptZh.traditional: 你兩個星期沒倒垃圾，媽媽很生氣。用「讓」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你两个星期没倒垃圾，妈妈很生气。用「让」说。

items.sub: 我已經兩個星期沒倒垃圾了，所以媽媽很生氣。

sentence.traditional: 我已經兩個星期沒倒垃圾了，讓媽媽很生氣。
sentence.simplified: 我已经两个星期没倒垃圾了，让妈妈很生气。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng liǎng ge xīngqí méi dào lèsè le, ràng māma hěn shēngqì.
sentence.english: I had gone two weeks without taking out the trash, which made my mom angry.

repairs.note: 被 marks who did something to you; here not taking out the trash made mom angry.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 兩個星期 + 沒倒垃圾 + 了 + 讓媽媽 + 很生氣.
items.successNote: A 讓 B + feeling: A is the cause.

items.prompt: You are excited about traveling tomorrow, so you cannot sleep. Rewrite it with 讓.

promptZh.traditional: 明天要去旅行，你很興奮，所以睡不著。用「讓」說。
promptZh.simplified: 明天要去旅行，你很兴奋，所以睡不着。用「让」说。

items.sub: 我一想到明天要去旅行，就很興奮，所以睡不著。

sentence.traditional: 我一想到明天要去旅行，就讓我很興奮，所以睡不著。
sentence.simplified: 我一想到明天要去旅行，就让我很兴奋，所以睡不着。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ yì xiǎngdào míngtiān yào qù lǚxíng, jiù ràng wǒ hěn xīngfèn, suǒyǐ shuì bu zháo.
sentence.english: Whenever I think about traveling tomorrow, it makes me so excited that I cannot sleep.

repairs.note: 讓 comes before the person and the feeling.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 就讓 + 我很興奮 + 所以 + 睡不著.
items.successNote: The cause comes before 讓; the person and feeling follow it.

items.prompt: You do not like flying; just hearing about a flight makes you extremely nervous. Rewrite it with 讓.

promptZh.traditional: 你不喜歡坐飛機，一聽到坐飛機就緊張得不得了。用「讓」說。
promptZh.simplified: 你不喜欢坐飞机，一听到坐飞机就紧张得不得了。用「让」说。

items.sub: 我不喜歡坐飛機，一聽到坐飛機就緊張得不得了。

sentence.traditional: 我不喜歡坐飛機，一聽到坐飛機就讓我緊張得不得了。
sentence.simplified: 我不喜欢坐飞机，一听到坐飞机就让我紧张得不得了。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ bù xǐhuān zuò fēijī, yì tīngdào zuò fēijī jiù ràng wǒ jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo.
sentence.english: I do not like flying; just hearing about flying makes me extremely nervous.

repairs.note: 被 marks an action done to someone; here the flight causes the feeling, so use 讓.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 就讓 + 我 + 緊張 + 得不得了.
items.successNote: 讓 links a cause to a person's feeling.

items.prompt: Your mom is angry because of your room. Choose the right word to fix the sentence.

promptZh.traditional: 媽媽因為你的房間很生氣。這個句子不對，選一個對的。
promptZh.simplified: 妈妈因为你的房间很生气。这个句子不对，选一个对的。

repairs.note: 給媽媽 means for mom; here the room causes the feeling, so 讓媽媽.
對媽媽 means angry at mom, not making her angry.

items.takeOutNote: Do not take it out; swap 把 for 讓: the room is the cause.
items.hint: The room causes the feeling; use the cause marker.

result.traditional: 我的房間讓媽媽很生氣。
result.simplified: 我的房间让妈妈很生气。
result.pinyin: Wǒ de fángjiān ràng māma hěn shēngqì.
result.english: My room made my mom angry.

items.successNote: A 讓 B + feeling: A is the cause.

items.prompt: A thief stole your car, and you were very sad. Say it with 被 and 讓.

promptZh.traditional: 小偷偷了你的車，你很傷心。用「被」和「讓」說。
promptZh.simplified: 小偷偷了你的车，你很伤心。用「被」和「让」说。

items.sub: 小偷偷了你的車，你很傷心。

sentence.traditional: 我的車被偷了，讓我很傷心。
sentence.simplified: 我的车被偷了，让我很伤心。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒ de chē bèi tōu le, ràng wǒ hěn shāngxīn.
sentence.english: My car was stolen, which made me very sad.

repairs.note: 把 needs the doer first: 小偷把車偷了; here the car is the subject of 被.

items.fallbackRepair: Say 我的車 + 被偷了 + 讓我 + 很傷心.
items.successNote: 被 marks what happened; 讓 marks the feeling it caused.
